description:
On a desktop (1280x900, no touch screen), standalone inline-code URLs are clickable. Conversation /c/{{SLUG}} has one agent reply rendered from markdown with five paragraphs: "Preview: `https://example.com/preview?q=one&other=two#fragment`", "Command: `curl https://example.com/command`", "Two URLs: `https://one.example https://two.example`", "Explicit link: [`https://example.com/label`](https://example.com/destination)" and a fenced code block holding https://example.com/fenced. The test serves https://example.com itself: every page there is "

Preview destination

". "The content" is the last ".message-agent .markdown-content" element; "the link" is the a[href="https://example.com/preview?q=one&other=two#fragment"] inside it. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. The link should be visible (allow 30s). 3. The "code" inside the link must have exactly the text "https://example.com/preview?q=one&other=two#fragment". 4. That code element must have the computed CSS display exactly "inline". 5. The link's target attribute must be exactly "_blank" and its rel exactly "noopener noreferrer". 6. There must be exactly 2 "a" elements inside the content. 7. The content's 'a[href="https://example.com/destination"] code' must have exactly the text "https://example.com/label". 8. The content's "pre code" must have exactly the text "https://example.com/fenced". 9. There must be exactly 0 "pre a" elements inside the content. 10. Click the link (a real click). 11. It opens a popup: in tab "popup", the URL must be exactly "https://example.com/preview?q=one&other=two#fragment" (an exact URL check). 12. In tab "popup", the "h1" must have exactly the text "Preview destination". 13. In tab "popup", eval window.opener === null must give true. 14. Close tab "popup".
